constraints.statement: Extend examples/service-data-affinity/cluster-harness.js as the sole local child lifecycle owner; migrate the affinity demo duplicate spawn/kill mechanics. Keep its higher-level restart policy unchanged and record unrelated defects.

Use process.execPath and absolute src/index.js with distinct identities, data and listener ports; scrub inherited node configuration and prevent .env reloading. No shared process-global node state, forged readiness/cache/bootstrap payloads, NODE_ENV=test or altered product retry/election/cadence settings.

Fresh C contacts a transparent proxy of real B first: the proxy forwards real readiness and drops exactly the first bootstrap POST. Prove ContactSeedPhase rotates to B at attempt2 using its real diagnostics, not merely entrypoint dead-peer preselection.

One owning handle acquires from spawn, races readiness with early exits, signals all children before waiting, and awaits close plus both pipe and log completion. Teardown is single-flight; forced kills, nonzero exits and cleanup errors remain loud typed outcomes.

Preserve both scenario paths, classifications and assertion meanings. No outer join retries, timeout increases, policy relaxation or raised ratchets. Integration leaf tests must meet30seconds; an overrun is a performance or owner blocker, never a green acceptance receipt.

Do not edit transport runtime as a fixture workaround. The separately reviewed message-router-shutdown-lifetime Quest owns transport changes. Record and disposition the wider logical-node census rather than claiming two migrations cure all fixtures.
